semantic_reviews.reason: Common estimator checks call fit(), which indirectly enters fit_predict(), but discard its returned labels. The patch only moves the final E-step so fit_predict returns labels for the restored best parameters; fit() already restores the same best model state before and after the patch.

The patch adds warm_start to IsolationForest.__init__. Common checks observe the constructor parameter through get_params(), iterate and set it in check_set_params, and take the warm_start branch in check_fit_idempotent. The patch therefore changes values and control flow consumed by this test file.
The common test only hits _BaseChain.fit, whose golden-patch change is indentation-only. It never hits the newly added MultiOutputClassifier.fit implementation that carries the behavioral fix.
